diagrams.title: What happens in one sale
diagrams.note: Built: scanning, cashier-safe lookup, pricing, the discount limit with manager approval, payment and change, the bill number, and the one transaction that marks garments SOLD and writes the bill, audit and outbox (the register screen is PR #19, open). Not built: daybook rows, returns, receipts other than A4.
